title: Stop agent loops that make no progress
narrative: Fangore’s repair loop keeps asking the same question and getting the same answer. A versioned ceiling must end as no-progress — never fake success — and nested repair must share parent budget.
implementation:
`ConvergenceContract` / `ConvergenceGuard` fingerprint windows and nested budget slices. Escalation may request more evidence, but ceilings never count as task success.

Covers: POL-03.
